notes.title: Development updates!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33913856/d711fc05d3a53931250e53b32ab9b48c7375f83e.png[/img]

Unfortunately in the last months I was really busy. That is the reason why I  couldn't work on the new Country Desert Simulator. But now I spend my freetime to start developing the new simulator. We would kindly like to apologize for the inconvenience. 

Futhermore the new Desert Car is finally integrated in the new Unreal Engine 4 version. That's amazing! Brilliant graphics expect you :) Some new pics :D Enjoy it and stay tuned!! 

This car DLC will be included in one DLC package. Don't worry it's fully for free :) 

[b]Now finished: [/b]
[list]
[*] UI components
[*] UE4 BIG UPDATE 
[*] Main Navigation 
[*] Setups for development 
[*] DLC Support 
[*] STEAM Support 
[/list]
[b]Enjoy it and stay tuned :) [/b]

Yours 
Benjamin Zekavica
